title: Publish atomic planning group promotions
description: Implement the mutating provider promotion operation under one global lock. Re-run filter selection and dependency-closure validation inside the lock, capture one timestamp, convert every selected planned record to todo while preserving UUID, shortId, createdAt, all metadata, comments, dependencies, assignee, and reusableTaskIds, clear execution lifecycle timestamps, and advance updatedAt monotonically. Publish the prepared journal, todo snapshots, committed journal, source removals, directory syncs, and final journal removal so success is all-or-nothing and recoverable. Return promoted views in deterministic selection order. Cover concurrent promotion/update attempts, cross-branch IDs, executable blockers, every fault boundary, rollback, roll-forward, retry, and exact byte preservation outside allowed fields.
